en.shortDescription: Single-socket SP3 board for EPYC 7002/7003 with 4 × PCIe 4.0 x16, 3 × M.2 NVMe and dual 2.5 GbE in a standard ATX size.
en.description: The HUANANZHI H12D-8D brings EPYC to a regular ATX case. Eight DDR4 channels (up to 2 TB), four full-length PCIe 4.0 x16 slots for GPUs or NVMe cards, three M.2 NVMe slots and three SFF-8643 ports for up to 12 extra SATA drives or U.2 SSDs make it a great base for home labs, render boxes and AI workstations.
en.name: HUANANZHI H12D-8D 1P

specs.SATA / SAS connectors: 4 × SATA 3.0 + 3 × SFF-8643 (each = 4 × SATA or 1 × U.2 PCIe 4.0 x4)
specs.USB: Rear: 4 × USB 3.2 Gen1, 2 × USB 2.0; front headers: 1 × USB 3.2 Gen1, 1 × USB 2.0
specs.Remote management (BMC): Not included (optional AST2500 module can be added)

notes: This version has no BMC: no IPMI remote management and the rear VGA port is inactive – you need a graphics card for display output.
